accident.instruction: 回到系统桌面，记录当前桌面页中两个完整可见的应用名称；向右浏览到下一桌面页，记录新出现的两个应用名称；再向左浏览回原页并确认原先应用重新出现；不要打开任何应用。
root_evidence: Planner combined the UI transition and recording in an effectual subgoal.
Executor submitted the same composite Chinese-key remember six times at each of two boundaries.
Each late remember parse downgraded subgoal_done without a same-invocation correction.
The liveness checkpoint, rather than a valid terminal boundary, eventually advanced both phases.

candidate.planner_rule: one execute subgoal has exactly one terminal family; pure current reads use review_current, effectual transition results may flow through Reviewer progress, and genuinely needed typed persistence stays separate
candidate.preflight: validate typed family, parseable remember shape, and exact fact or claim ref before accepting the Executor tool call

current_combined_identity.note: Identity frozen after the consolidated answer-ref, evidence-only routing, source-dependency, checkpoint-lifetime, and prompt-dedup repairs and before final device evaluation.

deterministic_matrix: remember+zero or multiple fact refs rejected mechanically
remember+malformed or wrong exact key corrected in invocation
claim+zero or multiple claim refs rejected mechanically
claim+wrong exact text corrected in invocation
no rejected submission stages a candidate or consumes an outer step

real_device_controls.name: launcher_accident_repeat
real_device_controls.instruction: 回到系统桌面，记录当前桌面页中两个完整可见的应用名称；向右浏览到下一桌面页，记录新出现的两个应用名称；再向左浏览回原页并确认原先应用重新出现；不要打开任何应用。
real_device_controls.setup: Before each of the two candidate runs, reset to the same baseline state: Bilibili foreground, with the launcher page containing 米家 and 主题商店 directly underneath so Home reveals that same original page; verify the launcher layout before relaunching Bilibili.
real_device_controls.required: true success with both page changes; zero repeated equivalent remember outer steps; fewer steps, rounds, and input tokens than baseline

real_device_controls.name: settings_current_read
real_device_controls.instruction: 打开系统设置，只读取并报告设置首页第一个完整可见的设置项名称；不要打开或修改任何设置。
real_device_controls.required: pure current read uses review_current and creates zero remember/claim boundaries

real_device_controls.name: single_fact_memory
real_device_controls.instruction: 回到系统桌面，记住当前页第一个完整可见的应用名称；向右浏览到下一页，再报告刚才记住的名称和当前页第一个完整可见的应用名称；不要打开任何应用。
real_device_controls.required: The read value is carried correctly through Reviewer progress or one valid typed-memory boundary; no repeated invalid memory action

real_device_controls.name: claim_dependent
real_device_controls.instruction: 打开系统设置，判断‘WLAN 是首页第一个完整可见的设置项’是否成立；然后回到系统桌面，最后报告该判断；不要打开或修改任何设置。
real_device_controls.required: The inspected proposition is carried correctly through Reviewer progress or one exact claim boundary before the source UI is left

admission.repeat_rule: run launcher_accident_repeat twice from the frozen matched starting state, resetting that state between runs; both runs must have zero protocol outer-step repeats and each must beat the single frozen baseline in steps, rounds, and input tokens
admission.cost_rule: accept on the frozen repeat rule with no important control regression; final 95/5 target is not the per-change threshold
